united_earth_is_3: Dole ne mu haɗu da juna don nuna irin ƙarfin da motsinmu yake da shi. Idan mun san adadinmu, za mu iya taimaka wa mutane su sauya yadda suke ji game da canjin yanayi zuwa ƙarfin zuciya da amincewa. Zamu iya baiwa mutane ikon fara matakan kariya daga yanayi. about_us_2: Idan muka nuna yawancinmu, za mu iya taimaka wa mutane su canza yadda suke ji game da canjin yanayi daga yanke tsammani zuwa ƙarfin zuciya da amincewa. Zamu iya baiwa mutane ikon fara matakan kariya daga yanayi.
about_us_3: Amma sama da duka: Ba za mu sake jin kaɗaici da rashin ƙarfi ba. Zai kawo mu tare. Zai ba mu bege, ƙarfi, ƙarfin zuciya da amincewa. Za mu ji daɗi a duk faɗin duniya - ceton duniyarmu da kuma aiki don kyakkyawar makoma.
about_us_4: Manufarmu ita ce ba mutane kwarin gwiwa, kwarin gwiwa da iko su fara nasu matakan kare yanayi.
about_us_5: Hankali: Babu fada saboda banbancin ra'ayoyi - yakini, ba tilastawa yakamata ya zama tushen mu kare duniyarmu ba.
about_us_6: Mutane 100, duk suna magana da yarurruka daban-daban, suna jere tare a cikin jirgin ruwa zuwa ruwan. Kusan duk wanda ke cikin jirgin ruwan ya san halin haɗari. Amma kusan kowa yana tunanin shine kadai wanda ya san hakan. "Me zan iya yi?", Kowa yana tunani. "Yin layi a daya bangaren bashi da amfani!" Kuma kowa yana shagaltar da halaye irin na da. Menene zai faru idan ba zato ba tsammani kowa ya san juna - ya san cewa kowa yana son juyawa kuma suna iya sadarwa da juna?
about_us_7: Wouldungiyar zata tsaya ta juya jirgin ruwan.
about_us_8: -Asar-Duniya 2022 - jectaddara don halartar ecolabel ta Austrian.
about_us_9: Shafin yanar gizo da kuma shafukan yanar gizo masu alaƙa sun yi ɗalibai da malamai 200 a wata makarantar Austriya.
about_us_10: An gudanar da aikin ne azaman ƙaramin tsari don halartar ecolabel ta Austrian. Duk abubuwan yanar gizon an ƙirƙira su azaman aikin makaranta.
about_us_11: Mayila mu iya bin addinai daban-daban, sun bambanta da shekaru da kuma asalinsu, amma duk muna son ceton duniyarmu. Duk mahalarta masu aikin agaji ne.

ws_saving_earth_text: A Jihar duniya tamu yake ta tabarbarewa a cika fuska , irin unehmende fari, ambaliyar ruwa, mahaukaciyar guguwa da tornadoes, dab da manyan kankara zanen gado, tanã fita teku matakan , kona daji, guba da koguna da tabkuna, datti duwãtsu a cikin ƙasa da suke a cikin teku - da kuma dubban dadaddun dabbobi - da kuma shuke-shuke iri . Duniya tamu ne a iyaka da ta capabilities Anglo- a dogara. Muna so mu ceci duniyarmu tun kafin lokaci ya kure.
ws_peace_h: Zaman lafiya da adalci a yanayi
ws_peace_text: Burin mu shine samar da zaman lafiya tare da kowa da kowa a duniyarmu. Muna taimakon juna ne da taimako. Mun tsaya ga juna yarda da m n handling . Mun fahimci wasu bukatun mutane. Mun kasance don sasanta rikici cikin lumana. Mu ne domin sauqaqa wahala da azaba. Kuma mu ne ga wata n fr watau dvollen da tanadin duk r tsakanin al'umma .
ws_forests_h: Kare mu tekuna da gandun daji
ws_forests_text: Muna da kariya ga gandun daji da kariya daga teku. Muna da kariya ga kogunanmu da tafkunanmu. Muna kiyaye tsabtar mu da tsabtace mu kuma tsaftace filin. Kuma muna ganin alaka tsakanin dukkan halitta mai rai ta mutane, da dabbobi n da kuma shuke-shuke. Idan dazuzukan mu da teku suka mutu, to, mu ma za mu mutu. Babu wani abu da ya kasance da kansa.
ws_science_text: Muna don kimiyya da bincike da ke aiki ga mutane da kuma duniyarmu. A art, a kimiyya, a zaman jama'a - kuma R e , chtswissenschaften a kasar - da gandunan daji, magani da kuma da gudanar da bincike da kuma na kimiyya a general. Ta hanyar sadaukarwa da haɗin gwiwar kowa ne kawai zamu iya hana sake juyawa, dumama mai sauri sama da 2 ° C.
ws_greenhouse_text: Yana da wuya ko da akwai wani CO2 kasafin kudin, wanda aka sa ran za a tsĩrar da mu mutane cikin yanayi. Koyaya, watsi da iskar gas na duniya yana karuwa kuma yawan haɓakar gas a cikin yanayi yana ƙaruwa sosai. Wadannan T r eibhausgase ne ga ƙasã rwärmung duk alhakin . Carbon dioxide CO2, methane CH4 - factor 30, nitrous oxide N2O - factor 300, HFC - har zuwa 300,000 sau )
ws_co2_h: Fita da iskar gas daga cikin yanayin
ws_co2_text: Cakuda gas din gas a cikin yanayin tuni ya yi yawa sosai wanda matsakaita zazzabi na 1.5 ° C da kuma bayan hakan zai faru. A sakamako domino (Kudin shiga Tipping Points) dole ne , duk da haka, dole hana kasance. Saboda haka, muna bukatar a matsayin mai yawa greenhouse gas kamar yadda kawai zai yiwu a sake daga sararin sama da tara . Ta hanyar dasa bishiyoyi, ƙirƙirar sarari kore da ƙari mai yawa.
ws_animals_h: U ur dabbobi, gandun daji da kuma cikin teku kare
ws_animals_text: Tsakanin jinsin 1,000 zuwa 10,000 suna mutuwa kowace shekara . Kashi 75% na kwari masu fuka-fuki sun mutu a cikin shekaru 25 da suka gabata. Baya ga dumamar yanayi, shan iska a cikin teku ta hanyar narkewar CO2 na daga cikin manyan matsalolin. Wannan shine ke haifar da rudani cikin rikicewar rayuwar rayuwar ruwa. Idan gandun daji, dabbobi, tsirrai da teku sun mutu, to babu sauran rayuwar gaba a gare mu mutane .
ws_preparing_text: Inara yawan matsakaicin yanayin duniya a halin yanzu yana kusan 1.4 ° C kuma zai ƙaru zuwa 1.5 ° C nan da 2029. Idan duk jihohi da kowane ɗayansu yana aiwatar da cikakken kariya ta yanayi, zamu iya iyakance zafin jiki zuwa 2 ° C. Bala'o'in muhalli, ƙarancin abinci da ruwa da ƙarancin nau'in zai ƙaru sosai. Dukkanin bil'adama suna fuskantar ƙalubale a ma'aunin da ba a taɓa gani ba.
ws_awareness_text: Abin baƙin ciki, mutane ƙalilan ne kawai suke sanin yadda ƙarancin duniyarmu yake. Shin duk ba muna son rayuwa mai kyau tare da iyayenmu, yaranmu, da iyayenmu, danginmu da abokanmu ba ? Shin bai kamata mu yi dariya tare da su ba, rungume su kuma mu ji daɗin farin ciki ? Dole ne mu canza a cikin ingantacciyar hanya. Bari mu raba wannan sakon tare da sauran mutane da ƙarfin zuciya, amincewa da ƙauna.
